name: The Slime God Core
victoryScreenHeader: You have conquered countless empires, you have ignited atomic fire, you have built countless wonders. But this time, your enemy is not another civilization. It is intelligent gelatinous beings. End them before the slimes take over the world, or become a piece of knowledge in their memory?
victoryString: It is dead. Or rather, it has finally stopped thinking. That mass of gel carrying billions of memories evaporated under the firepower of civilization, leaving only a gelatinous land—the sole evidence that it ever existed. You win. But your generals are silent after the battle. Because everyone asks the same question: Did we defeat the last Slime God, or the first?
